fields.description: Solera pairs compact apartments with larger terrace homes in Downtown Mina, across three buildings connected by a shared podium.

research.locationNote: Downtown Mina, on Raha Island; not a promise of direct beach frontage.
research.priceNote: The June 2025 launch advertised AED 768,000; the factsheet starts at AED 808,000. Neither verifies today’s available-unit price.
research.paymentNote: The factsheet calls 50 / 50 standard. The table adds Property Finder’s 10 / 40 / 50 breakdown; its 65 / 35 alternative requires offer confirmation.
research.handoverNote: The developer targets Q2 2028; the original launch anticipated the end of April 2028. Both are forecasts, not completion certificates.
